name: 90s Games
details: A large zero-dependency collection. The repository includes games such as 2048, Asteroids, Breakout, Frogger, Minesweeper, Pong, Snake, Sokoban, Space Invaders, Tetris, runners, puzzles, rhythm games and many more.

name: Tiny Arcade
details: Pure frontend game library with no backend or tracking according to the project repository.

name: Game-Zone
details: Multi-page browser arcade with games including Soccer Slime, typing challenges, Whack-a-Mole, puzzles and other arcade titles.

name: Temple Run Browser Game
details: Canvas runner with lanes, jumping, sliding, turn gates, coins, scoring and increasing difficulty.

name: Endless Runner
details: Browser runner with obstacle spawning, parallax layers, jumping, sound, score and speed scaling.

name: HexGL
details: Well-known open-source futuristic browser racing project.

name: Crash Car
details: Browser driving game with coins, keyboard/mouse controls, shields, slow motion and point-magnet powerups.

name: Nordschleife Racer
license: MIT for original engine code; third-party assets separately credited
details: TypeScript + Three.js racing engine with custom vehicle physics, multiplayer and ghost replays.

name: APEX FORMULA 2026
license: Apache-2.0 for original project; Three.js MIT; asset provenance documented
details: Original browser racing simulator with documented third-party licensing and asset provenance.

name: Football Frenzy Arcade
details: Football browser arcade with penalty shootout, keepie-uppie physics and a football personality quiz.

name: Soccer.js
details: Open-source browser soccer project inspired by HaxBall-style gameplay.

name: Breakout
details: Canvas/DOM Breakout game with paddle controls, lives and block clearing.

name: HTML5 Platformer
details: Vanilla JavaScript side-scroller. Its art/music come from separately credited OpenGameArt creators.

name: Platformer + Level Editor
games: HTML5 platformer with JSON level editor
details: Simple platformer with an editor that exports and imports levels as JSON. Listed for discovery; license should be checked before bundling.

name: BrowserQuest
license: Open-source project; verify exact license/asset notices before redistribution
details: Mozilla browser RPG project useful as a reference for tile maps, realtime multiplayer and RPG interactions.
